candidate.user_input: What are the requirements for passcodes and patching on personal phones used to access GitLab-managed data?
candidate.reference: All personal mobile computing devices used to access GitLab-managed data, including but not limited to email and GitLab.com, must be passcode-enabled. Mobile computing best practices dictate that these devices should be running the latest version of the operating system available, and all new patches applied.
